title: Mother, Father, Brother, Daughter
label: ch:fa-family
canDo: I can name my mother, father, brother, and daughter in Persian, the four secure English cousins Chapter 6 named without teaching.

payoff.summary: The chapter closes on dokhtar, daughter, then runs all four family words back to back and reuses the ezafe from esm-e man ast and kelid-e man to say dokhtar-e man, my daughter.
